title: Dry run: twoSum on [3, 2, 4], target 6

steps.note: twoSum is called with arr = [3, 2, 4] and target = 6.
Outer loop: i = 0, so arr[i] = 3 is the first number of the pair.
Inner loop starts at j = i + 1 = 1, so it never pairs an element with itself.
arr[0] + arr[1] = 3 + 2 = 5. 5 is not 6, so keep going.
j++ makes j = 3. 3 < 3 is false, so the inner loop ends. Nothing pairs with 3.
i++ makes i = 1. Now arr[i] = 2 is the first number of the pair.
j = i + 1 = 2. Pairs with index 0 were already checked, so there's no need to look back.
arr[1] + arr[2] = 2 + 4 = 6. This matches the target!
Return {1, 2} right away. main prints [1,2], which matches the expected answer.
